The plate looks like a square side plate of about 22 cm. It holds three bacon strips, all cooked crisp. One is short, about 10 cm, and the other two are about 15 cm.

Cooked crisp bacon weighs about 8 g per full slice, and these look like thin slices. I estimate roughly 6 g for the short one and 8 g for each of the others, so about 22 g in total.

Cooked bacon has about 540 kcal per 100 g, so 22 g comes to roughly 120 kcal.
